utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, what still needs fixing for the repair drive, and what can I take off your list today?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I still need duct tape, a box of mixed screws, and a couple of work gloves—if you can grab any of those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can grab the duct tape and work gloves—do you want a specific tape width or glove size?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and ladder over for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d help a lot—sorry, I’m a little all over the place today. If you bring the drill and ladder, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries at all—I’ll bring the drill and ladder by before we get started.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, the repair drive’s the talk of the block—folks are saying turnout should be really strong this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear, but I just hope we’ve sorted parking and where everyone’s supposed to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re planning to put clear drop-off signs by the lot, and Marvin’s been nudging people to use the side street for parking.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the signup sheet mapped by street, and we still need two volunteers for Maple Court plus someone to cover the tool drop at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can cover the tool drop at the community center, and I’ll ask around for two Maple Court volunteers this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m pulling folks together for the repair drive—want me to count you in and pass the word along?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn, but I’d rather keep to myself right now; maybe just count me in quietly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course, I’ll keep it low-key and just count you in quietly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m pulling together the repair drive list now, so if you’ve got a few jobs to add, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — please add my lamp rewiring and the loose brake cable on my bike.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it, Leo — I’ve added the lamp rewiring and your bike’s loose brake cable to the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me which repairs we’ve already confirmed for the drive so I don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late catching up, but I know we already confirmed the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps are confirmed; is there anything else that’s been tentatively discussed, or just those two so far?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup times—what slot were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye—that helps. I was thinking late morning or early afternoon, so we can pick a slot that works around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late morning would be easiest for me—I need to be free by school pickup, so maybe 10 to noon if that works?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—are folks still collecting tools and supplies for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, we’re still gathering tools and basic supplies, and a few people are bringing spare parts too. If you want, I can connect you with Mara since she’s coordinating the drop-off list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d help, thanks—I’ve only heard second-hand updates, so getting Mara’s list would make it a lot easier to know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just tell me when and where, and I’ll swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time and location first? I’d rather know the details before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, sorry—I skimmed that. What time and where is it again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help a little—what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey—I've gone and lost track a bit, but I know the bench by the garden and that squeaky gate still need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at the gate first, if you want. Do you know who’s checking the bench?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m telling folks about the repair drive so we can get a good turnout, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good thinking—I'll check what tools and spare parts we’ve got so we know what to ask people to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect—I’ll keep spreading the word and let everyone know to bring any useful tools or spare parts once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, got it — I’m just out running errands, but tell me how the repair drive’s shaping up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s coming together pretty quietly—just a few folks offering tools and spare parts so far. If you want, I can fill you in properly when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, please do—I’m only catching bits while I’m out, but that sounds like a solid start.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Vik, I’m a bit fuzzy on the details—when’s the repair drive happening again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: The repair drive’s this Saturday morning at the community lot—I’ve been telling everyone so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, this Saturday morning at the community lot—thanks, Vik. I’d have shown up with my toolbox on the wrong day again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I was meaning to ask when we’re starting.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 9 by the community shed. Bring gloves if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, Saturday at 9 by the shed—got it. I’ll bring gloves if I can find mine.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my ladder and drill over for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d help a lot, Gus. If you come by around nine, we can make a clear list and start with the gutters.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, I’ll swing by around nine with the ladder and drill so we can start on the gutters.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn, I’m glad we’re talking about the repair drive—how can I help get it moving?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Mara, perfect timing—I’m inviting folks up and down the block already, and we could really use your help spreading the word and lining up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word on my end and ask around for a few volunteers today. If you want, I can also check who might have tools or a table we can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—want me to help pull a few folks together for it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please—that’d help a lot. I’ve got the church parking lot penciled in as the best spot, so if you can round up a few neighbors, I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll ask around today and try to line up a few handy neighbors, then I’ll circle back so you know who’s in and what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m pulling together the repair drive list now, and I’d love your help making sure we haven’t missed any neighbors who need something fixed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — I’ve got my notes, and I can help cross-check who still needs repairs or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Cleo — can we start with Maple Street and note who still needs repairs versus just supplies?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—are folks still collecting tools and supplies for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—people are still collecting. What can you bring: tools, parts, or cash for supplies?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can probably chip in some cash, but I’m still catching up—do you know what they need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just tell me when and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—let’s do Saturday after school drop-off, around 9:30. If you can bring a drill and some work gloves, that’d help a ton.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Works for me—I’ll swing by around 9:30 with the drill and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Kira—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s bringing tools and whether the sign-up sheet’s actually finalized?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can check on both—last I heard, Miguel was bringing most of the tools, but I’ll confirm and make sure the sign-up sheet’s finalized.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—are folks still collecting tools and money for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, sounds like they still are—I got here late, but I heard they’re taking both tools and a little cash.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know—I’d hate to show up with the wrong thing. Do you know who’s keeping track of the donations?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m glad you brought up the repair drive, Opal—when were you thinking we should get it organized?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d like to get it organized this Saturday morning at the community center, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday morning at the community center works for me—I can be there early to help set up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of supplies for the repair drive, so tell me what we’re still short on and I’ll check my stock.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what’s already on the list first? I’d rather check what we’re actually short on before I promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — right now I’ve got work gloves, duct tape, nails, extension cords, and two tarps on the list. If that matches what you’ve heard, we can figure out the gaps next.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, we’re rallying folks for the repair drive—come by if you can, and feel free to spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to know—I’m out running errands, but I’ll mention it to a couple folks if I see them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira—that helps a lot. We’ll be set up by the community center most of the afternoon if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning, Pia — I can help sort tools for the repair drive if you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Morning, Leo — that would help, but can we first make sure we know where everything will be stored and who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — let’s make a quick list for storage and who’s bringing each tool, then I’ll sort what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—want me to help pull a few folks from different blocks together for it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That could really help, Jules—before we start asking around, can we pin down the date and what kind of repairs we’re focusing on?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—let’s settle the date first, and I’d lean toward simple fixes like loose hinges, patching screens, and basic yard cleanup so it’s easy to rally people around.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey — I’m pulling together the repair drive list now; can you help me confirm who still needs supplies?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can help—if you tell me who’s already covered, I can think through who still needs supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect—so far I’ve got Ms. Alvarez covered for paint and the Johnsons covered for tools; can you help me figure out who’s still missing supplies?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard folks are putting together tools and spare parts for the repair drive—have you heard where they’re setting up?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think they’re setting up by the community hall, near the side entrance. I haven’t been by, but that’s what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that makes sense—the side entrance has plenty of room. I’ll pass that along in case anyone’s still asking where to bring things.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eli, how many homes still need repairs, and what do you need from me today?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Looks like about six homes still need work, and today I just need you to help me confirm who can take each house so we’ve got a clear plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Which six homes are they, and who’s already available to take each one?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam—repair drive’s still on, right? Just tell me what needs hauling and where.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, it’s still on—I need the busted bikes and scrap wood hauled over to the community center lot by noon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—busted bikes and scrap wood to the community center lot by noon. I’ll swing by and haul what I can.
